items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: And Lil Armstrong. That's where Lil met Louis. Lil Armstrong and Louis. That's where they was married.

ctx.x: That was the depression too. Those years. Yes it was. Very, very hard. Very, very hard. We did have a little money. We lost it all at Chicago Bank.

Then there was nothing. He couldn't get nothing. And then they went, as I say, Red Bank, New York, played around in there. And almost all the men was getting tired. Getting disgusted. So they broke up. Or we went to California. John Cincere came back here. Dutrie, I think he went to California too. But he passed. Yes, he didn't live long. He didn't live long at all. Because he was gassed in the Army. That's what I heard. Yes. And that caused his death, you see. He was a fine musician. And then we went. It comes…
Well that was the one on Market Street in San Francisco. Oh, on Market Street. That's right. I took a picture of that place. It's still there. It's still there, yes. It's a pool hall now, isn't it?
